description: This file defines the NoteListWidgetService class, which extends Android's RemoteViewsService. It provides a method to create and return a NoteListWidgetFactory for populating a widget with note list views in the Android Notes app.

classes.name: NoteListWidgetService
classes.description: A service that provides remote views for a widget displaying a list of notes.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a NoteListWidgetFactory instance to supply views to the widget.
